body: Founder asked to get the stickers project moving via the Mid-Piano team brainstorming ideas as a blog post. Read the existing 'Mid-Piano Presents' corpus (the-mark, the-new-guys, the-wall-undefeated, the-band-name origin) for voice/format before writing, per instruction. Read the real S135 VS0 sticker brief (EMILY/docs/merch/stickers_vs0_brief.md) first -- current locked scope is 3 minimal brand-mark SKUs (Emily Prime Mark, Wordmark, Logotype), nothing character-driven. Wrote a full Mid-Piano Presents episode where the cast pitches 6 real, printable sticker concepts grounded in their own established bits: Duck's holographic 'ASSET' reveal, Frog's fully-redacted sticker, a real Mid-Piano band mark (piano key mid-press) as a companion line to the existing corporate SKUs rather than a competitor, Pizza's glow-in-the-dark 'STILL HOT', the Tree's untranslated French line printed as-is, Gary's deliberately under-scoped clipboard sticker. Also surfaces the real, still-open blocker honestly in-scene: none of this prints itself, S135-02's vendor pick is still the gate. Published live via the documented IDUNA blog API workflow (OKEMILY/CLAUDE.md's 'publish it yourself' path): https://okemily.com/blog/mid-piano-presents-the-stickers/ . No git commit needed -- blog content lives in IDUNA/var/blog.db, not version-controlled, per house convention.
title: Mid-Piano Presents: The Stickers — published, real sticker concepts brainstormed for S135 VS0 merch
